title: ldap: add couple OIDs coming from Active Directory specs
description:
Couple OIDs coming from the \[MS-ADTS] spec https://winprotocoldoc.blob.core.windows.net/productionwindowsarchives/MS-ADTS/[MS-ADTS].pdf
See each commit message for details and sources.

I noticed the issue when working on this attached PCAP: [ldap_cap_active_directory.pcapng](/uploads/9ca0fc13c30bd91ab534bcf20b25b58b/ldap_cap_active_directory.pcapng) and I noticed the following unresolved or differently named OIDs:
![image](/uploads/8edb76fb5cafef018c2a266b47cab7a1/image.png)

In comparison with this new code:
![image](/uploads/7901705948b81e8bd504a5ed9822a39f/image.png)
![image](/uploads/b65d0f613285c3200a361bec917b5742/image.png)

notes.body:
Hi Clément,

You should add those changes in the epan/dissectors/asn1/ldap/packet-ldap-template.c file instead and regenerate the dissector.
Sorry I missed that! It should be good now :smile:
